comment: Persona decision registry. Hash-verified v2 evidence distills machine-readable policy trees; legacy v1 prose remains audit history and is not automation-eligible until re-earned through shipped player input.

contract.legacy_policy: prose nodes remain visible but cannot execute until re-earned by v2 evidence

nodes.rule: A committed striker (windup/charge/impact/recover) is not tracking you: abort the leg and break for the nearest cover while it is busy.

legacy_sources: sprint_gap_eazy_2026-07-31 (endo's bar hit zero on a leg the leader funded)

nodes.rule: Party members drain differently - check EVERY bar before a party sprint; the slowest bar sets the plan.
nodes.source: sprint_gap_eazy_2026-07-31 (endo's bar hit zero on a leg the leader funded)

nodes.rule: Dean clicks the visible UPPER DECK > ARM NEXT MID prompt without checking whether it advances the puzzle.
Dean ignores the visible DECK ACCESS marker and issues a pointless Rally toward an arbitrary screen-space floor target.
Eazy prioritizes the visible UPPER DECK > ARM NEXT MID prompt before wandering to another floor target.
When REST PARTY is visible, gather the full party on the marked shelter with one held Rally before interacting.
Eazy reads the visible instructions and rallies the full party toward the marked DECK ACCESS target in screen-space.
Eazy prioritizes the visible REST PARTY prompt before wandering to another floor target.
Run watched ground, walk safe ground; never start a watched leg below the stamina it costs.
When a room's owner stands at the far end of its observed walk, the window is open NOW — go; waiting for better spends it.
Patrol reach = walk line + detect + pursuit. Never extrapolate from partial samples; a dash is only legal once the loop is known.
Before committing to any route, hold at cover and sample every threat's walk until it stops surprising you (its observed extents stop growing).

nodes.rule: A downed member costs the retrieve round-trip under watch plus the revive wait - always slower than the window you tried to skip.
A commit needs a settled body, a SELECTED character, standing within the interaction radius. Walk the actor to the console, wait a beat, then fire.

nodes.retired: 2026-07-31: the party rest now ABSORBS an in-shelter solo rester (director's pick; the sanctuary-revive rest yields to the group bed-down). Kept as history - the trace that motivated the rule change.
nodes.rule: A sanctuary revive leaves the body in its own rest, which blocks the group bed-down - nudge everyone awake, settle, then commit the rest.
